sentences.en: We could meet downtown. Would that be convenient for you?
sentences.zh: 我们可以在市中心见面。对你方便吗？

sentences.en: Please tell me which bus to take to go downtown.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我去市中心应该乘坐哪路公交车。

sentences.en: There was an enormous traffic jam in downtown Kyoto.
sentences.zh: 在京都闹市区发生了严重的交通堵塞。
